verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud has automations (built-in Sales Flows) and a deployment lifecycle: Agentforce DevOps Center lets teams build, test, and deploy apps and agents. The official sf CLI with scratch orgs and an 'easy deployment path' supports a source-driven workflow where automations could be versioned and reviewed. However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents version history, change review, or rollback of Flows or agents. Missing for 10: explicit automation versioning/version history, a documented review/approval step for automation changes, a documented rollback capability, and independent hands-on corroboration of this workflow.
